params.name: type
params.description: Filter results by type. enum: `ap`, `gateway`, `switch`

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter by MAC address. Partial matches may use `*` wildcards (e.g. `*5b35*` matches `5c5b350e0001` and `5c5b35000301`). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: model
params.description: Partial / full Device model. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `AP4*` and `*P4*` match `AP43`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*43`) are not supported. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: name
params.description: Device name. Always a partial match (e.g. `london` will match `london-1`, `london-2`, `my-london-device`...). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Filter inventory results by site identifier. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: serial
params.description: Device serial number. Partial match allowed with wildcard * (e.g. `*123*` will match `AB123CD`, `12345`, `XY123`). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: master
params.description: Filter inventory results by whether the device is the Virtual Chassis master

params.name: sku
params.description: Device SKU. Partial match allowed with wildcard * (e.g. `*2300*` will match `EX2300-F-12P`). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: version
params.description: Device version. Partial match allowed with wildcard * (e.g. `2R3` will match `21.2R3-S3.5`). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: status
params.description: Device status. enum: `connected`, `disconnected`. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: text
params.description: Wildcards for name, mac, serial

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search organization inventory records with filters for type, MAC address, model, name, site, serial number, Virtual Chassis master state, SKU, version, status, and text.
